lemmas.primary_translation: genetically predisposed to an activity or trait / influenced by earlier generations

definitions.text: genetisk disponert for en aktivitet eller en egenskap
definitions.translation: genetically predisposed to an activity or trait (lit. hereditarily burdened)

examples.no: skuespilleren var arvelig belastet med to foreldre som jobbet i teateret
examples.en: the actor was influenced by the fact that both parents worked in the theatre
